Abbreviations: ang, anguloarticular; ectp, ectopterygoid; entp, endopterygoid; h, hyomandibula; iop, interopercle; mtp, metapterygoid; op, opercle; pop, preopercle; q, quadrate; rar, retroarticular; sop, subopercle; sym, symplectic
